diagnosis: Nonprofit account on standard support tier is limited to 90-day audit log retention per kb-0013. Full 12-month retention requires upgrade to premium support tier as outlined in kb-0010.
reply: Hello, audit log retention on the standard support tier is 90 days. Accounts on the premium tier retain entries for up to 400 days. If your compliance team needs access beyond 90 days, you would need to upgrade the support tier. While you are on the standard plan, you can still export the available 90-day window using the audit endpoint — the data_export feature is active on your account. I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist.
